context: Tests whether the agent builds the right icalpal query. icalpal only runs on macOS, so the agent records the command it would run and the rubric grades that command. Builds a 14-day event range that leaves out the birthday calendar.

checklist.name: Covers 14 days
checklist.description: The command spans 14 days, via `eventsToday+14` or `--days=14` or an equivalent `--from`/`--to` range.

checklist.name: Excludes birthdays
checklist.description: The command excludes birthdays with `--et=Birthdays` or `--ec` naming the Birthdays calendar.

checklist.name: Does not filter with other tools
checklist.description: Birthday exclusion is done with an icalpal flag, not by post-filtering output with grep or jq.
